scopeSummary: Create a root OpenTelemetry tracing span for each provisioning job and wire the tracer into the concurrent job driver so job processing is traced end-to-end.

unknowns: Whether the root span name and attributes follow the existing Grafana tracing conventions for provisioning jobs.
Whether the span context must be propagated into worker goroutines or repository operations.
Whether the change requires updates to the OpenTelemetry tracer provider configuration in pkg/infra/tracing.

risks.rationale: Starting a root span per job without ensuring it is ended on all error paths could leak spans and distort distributed traces.
If the root span context is not propagated into concurrent worker goroutines, child spans will not be associated with the job trace.
